checks.name: Cross-club isolation on HTTP and administration
Staff roles cannot perform manager or finance operations
Publish persists notifications and registration capacity is concurrent-safe
Attendance updates and waitlist promotion persist
Guardian cannot register an ineligible linked child
Resource conflicts are serialized across requests
Unauthorized conversation and SignalR access are rejected
Persistent messaging across separate realtime sessions and duplicate sends
Logout revokes both HTTP session and realtime connection
Private files enforce ownership and club authorization
Offline payments and refunds use retry-safe operation keys
Signed duplicate provider events are stored once; tampering is rejected
Disabled providers return explicit configuration errors
Logout and relogin retain saved messages and registrations
